Slide.Title: early(adjective)
Slide.SlideText: early(adjective) Definition: Definition: at or near the beginning, especially the beginning of the day; before the expected time; opposite of “late” Synonyms: Synonyms: beforehand; premature Examples: Examples: It’s too early to get up. Slide.Title: ecology (noun)

Slide.Title: emergency(noun)

Slide.Title: environment (noun)
